detail.desc: {AWAKEN_1191#<color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blade</color> will also automatically activate after the third hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Saw Teeth Trimming</color> or a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, dealing multiple hits of <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> to enemies in a large area ahead. <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blade</color> <color=#2BAD00>reduces DEF by 30%</color> for 15s upon hit. When the additional <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blade</color> is triggered, the skill's <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by 25%</color>, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.}{NOAWAKEN_1191#The 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Sharknami</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Reef Rock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color> <color=#2BAD00>trigger an additional Icy Blade</color>, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> to <color=#2BAD00>enemies in a large area in front</color> and <color=#2BAD00>reducing their DEF by 30%</color>. When the additional <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blade</color> is triggered, the skill's <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by 25%</color>, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Additional <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blades</color> don't affect the original skill's alts.}
